text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon broadcast on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The state budget for the first quarter of 1997 was 1.176 billion litas a 27 percent increase over the same period last year.

- The opposition Lithuanian Democratic Labour Party's (LDDP) faction in parliament intend to urge the president to veto the law on restitution of real estate if it is passed in parliament. The LDDP does not like the clause which places no limites on the amount of land which can be restored to pre-WWII owners. The LDDP is also opposed to the clause which allows property to be returned to those who do not live in the country permanently.
